title: Subagent delegation
patterns: 只在需要时.{0,8}(?:子\s*agent|子智能体)
(?:并行|委派).{0,10}(?:子任务|子\s*agent|子智能体)
when: Complex tasks containing independent bounded deliverables where parallel work can improve time or quality. No delegation for trivial tasks, no-agent instructions, or unavailable/unauthorized collaboration tools.
